Last month, after launching the first batch of GPT-6 models, OpenAI announced today the launch of new GPT-6 models designed for everyday ChatGPT conversations, along with the introduction of a brand-new Intelligent UI. Details are as follows.

ChatGPT introduces GPT-6 and Intelligent UI

OpenAI announced today that GPT-6 Sol will soon be rolled out to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, while GPT-6 Luna will begin rolling out to free users and Go users starting tomorrow.

According to OpenAI, this batch of GPT-6 models has been fine-tuned for everyday conversations and introduces the Intelligent UI — a new feature that enables ChatGPT to dynamically combine text, visual elements, and interactive elements based on the content of the questions and answers.

Below is OpenAI's introduction:

With the Intelligent UI, responses can include images, clickable buttons, forms, charts, and interactive experiences that you can use directly within the conversation. The format depends on what you ask. Comparison-type questions are best displayed side by side; explanatory content may be easier to understand through interactive charts. When a simple text answer is most useful, ChatGPT can provide that as well.

In today's launch post, OpenAI demonstrated how different prompts could potentially generate answers equipped with different visual aids.

For more complex prompts, ChatGPT can generate interactive widgets that allow users to explore concepts or adjust inputs to see how the results change.

ChatGPT can now also build interactive tools directly within the conversation, such as calculators, AA bill-splitting counters, and games. OpenAI stated that with GPT-6, ChatGPT can begin responding while still thinking, progressively adding information to the reply as the reasoning process unfolds, without having to wait for the entire reasoning process to complete before delivering the answer.
